enchantments.tooltip: +15 Enhancement Bonus: +15 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.

Nearly Finished: This item isn't quite finished, but it's only a step away from completion. Bring it to a Cannith Reforging Station and combine it with melted materials to restore this item to its full potential.

children.tooltip: Completed Weapon: This item is fully completed, and as a result deals an additional .5W damage.

enchantments.tooltip: Mind Tear: This weapon tears at the identity of your foes, reducing their MRR and Spell Power.

Holy 6: This weapon is wielded by the pure to smite the wicked, dealing an additional 6d6 good damage on each hit. This effect makes the weapon good aligned. Evil characters wielding this weapon will suffer one negative level.
Blunted Ammunition: The ammunition fired by this weapon deals blunt damage in addition to its other damage types.
Mythic Weapon Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
